_meta.note: ArtPortal 前端唯一读取的数据文件。字段定义见需求第五节。任何字段都可能为 null,前端须优雅显示'未注明',绝不出现 undefined/null/空白框。
_meta.note_trust: trust=verified 表示已人工核实(仅人工可写);trust=auto 表示程序自动收录、未经人工逐条核实。本 seed 中国内官方机构 7 条经核对原文后标 verified,其余标 auto——若你不认可可随时改回。
_meta.note_evidence: 每条的原文逐字 evidence 不进本文件(pipeline 内部校验用),另存于 seed 说明。

opportunities.summary_zh: Point Pleasant Publishing 通过国际艺术家专题目录，精选创新和实验性当代艺术家，由策展人撰写深度分析，涵盖表演、摄影、视频、电影、纺织、装置、时尚、舞蹈、跨媒介等领域。无申请费。
opportunities.summary_en: Point Pleasant Publishing selects innovative and experimental contemporary artists through an international artist feature catalog, with in-depth analysis by curators, covering performance, photography, video, film, textiles, installation, fashion, dance, cross-media, etc. No application fee.

opportunities.id: artconnect-opportunities-nakanojo-biennale-2027
opportunities.title_zh: Nakanojo Biennale 2027
opportunities.title_en: Nakanojo Biennale 2027
opportunities.summary_zh: Nakanojo Biennale 2027 面向全球艺术家公开征集作品，展览地点包括日本群马县中之条町的历史城镇、学校、温泉区等。入选艺术家将获得制作支持和展览场地。
opportunities.summary_en: Nakanojo Biennale 2027 is open to artists worldwide, with exhibition venues including historic townscapes, schools, and hot spring areas in Nakanojo, Gunma Prefecture, Japan. Selected artists will receive production support and exhibition space.

opportunities.id: artconnect-opportunities-joan-wakelin-助学金
opportunities.title_zh: Joan Wakelin 助学金
opportunities.title_en: The Joan Wakelin Bursary
opportunities.summary_zh: 由皇家摄影学会与《卫报》合作管理，提供2000英镑用于制作关于海外社会纪实议题的摄影专题。仅资助新项目，不支持战争区域旅行。
opportunities.summary_en: Managed by the Royal Photographic Society in partnership with The Guardian, offering £2,000 for producing a photography feature on international social documentary issues. Only new projects are funded, and travel to war zones is not supported.

opportunities.id: agg-ceske-budejovice-ecoc-2028-perma-culture-art
opportunities.title_zh: 捷克布杰约维采 2028 欧洲文化之都:(永续)文化
opportunities.title_en: Ceske Budejovice ECOC 2028: (Perma)culture
opportunities.summary_zh: 为2028欧洲文化之都征集文化项目,围绕“(永续)文化”框架,呼应关爱地球、人与未来资源的理念;从过程、内容与影响三个维度评审,重视参与式方法与长期社群效益。
opportunities.summary_en: Call for cultural projects for European Capital of Culture 2028, framed around 'Perma(Culture)', echoing care for the Earth, people, and future resources; evaluated from three dimensions: process, content, and impact, valuing participatory methods and long-term community benefits.

opportunities.id: agg-core-echo-2027-international-open-call-3-week-re-art
opportunities.title_zh: CORE ECHO 2027 国际征集与三周艺术家驻留
opportunities.title_en: CORE ECHO 2027 International Open Call & 3-Week Residency

eligibility.nationality: 面向国际招募10位艺术家

opportunities.summary_zh: 面向国际招募10位艺术家,与粤港澳大湾区的科技企业协作共创,进入工业设施将技术与材料转化为艺术作品;驻留于2026年8月5-25日进行,2027年3月开幕展出。
opportunities.summary_en: Open call for 10 international artists to collaborate with technology enterprises in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, transforming technology and materials into artworks in industrial facilities; residency from August 5-25, 2026, with an opening exhibition in March 2027.

opportunities.id: agg-art-moves-2026-billboard-art-competition-art
opportunities.title_zh: Art Moves 2026 广告牌艺术竞赛
opportunities.title_en: Art Moves 2026 Billboard Art Competition
opportunities.summary_zh: 竞赛围绕主题“恐惧还是勇气?我们如何停止畏惧明天、转而共同创造它?”征集作品,探讨恐惧如何塑造当代社会,并邀请艺术家思考“在恐惧中依然行动的决定”。
opportunities.summary_en: Competition based on the theme 'Fear or Courage? How can we stop fearing tomorrow and co-create it instead?' calls for works exploring how fear shapes contemporary society and inviting artists to reflect on 'the decision to act despite fear'.

opportunities.id: agg-extended-possibilities-residency-call-art
opportunities.title_zh: 延展的可能——驻留征集
opportunities.title_en: Extended Possibilities - Residency Call
opportunities.summary_zh: 一家行动主义艺术中心提供为期45天(2027年2月1日-3月15日)的驻留与技术支持,面向从事创作、研究或实验的艺术家或团队,鼓励与社会及解放议题相关的跨学科项目。
opportunities.summary_en: An activist art center offers a 45-day residency (February 1 - March 15, 2027) and technical support for artists or collectives engaged in creation, research, or experimentation, encouraging interdisciplinary projects related to social and liberation issues.

opportunities.id: agg-icci-art-valley-programme-international-visiting-art
opportunities.title_zh: ICCI 艺术谷计划——国际访问学者活动
opportunities.title_en: ICCI Art Valley Programme - International Visiting Scholars
opportunities.org_zh: ICCI 文化创意产业学院

eligibility.nationality: 面向全球艺术家与学者,不限国籍
eligibility.nationality_en: Open to artists and scholars worldwide, no nationality restrictions

opportunities.summary_zh: 招募5-6位国际访问艺术家或学者,围绕“艺术与科技”“人文对话”“城市参与”三个方向进行跨媒介、跨文化的当代艺术探索,成果将在上海多处场馆及文化地标展出(11月1日-12月15日)。
opportunities.summary_en: Recruiting 5-6 international visiting artists or scholars to conduct cross-media, cross-cultural contemporary art explorations around three themes: 'Art and Technology', 'Humanistic Dialogue', and 'Urban Participation'. The outcomes will be exhibited at multiple venues and cultural landmarks in Shanghai (November 1 - December 15).
opportunities.org_en: ICCI School of Cultural and Creative Industry

opportunities.id: agg-sciences-cinema-risc-very-short-film-competition-art
opportunities.title_zh: 科学与电影(RISC)超短片竞赛
opportunities.title_en: Sciences & Cinema (RISC) Very Short Film Competition
opportunities.summary_zh: 竞赛旨在推介兼具研究性与创造性的当代影片,并促进电影人、各学科科学家与广大观众(含青少年及学校团体)之间的交流与相遇。
opportunities.summary_en: The competition aims to promote contemporary films that are both research-oriented and creative, while fostering exchange and encounters between filmmakers, scientists from various disciplines, and a wide audience (including youth and school groups).

opportunities.id: agg-nicosia-ludic-lab-shape-new-works-for-toyful-mus-art
opportunities.title_zh: 尼科西亚游戏实验室:为 Toyful 音乐节创作新作
opportunities.title_en: Nicosia Ludic Lab: Shape New Works for Toyful Music Festival
opportunities.summary_zh: 驻留邀请作曲家与表演-研究者,通过“材料游戏”与“系统游戏”探索以“玩”为创作方法,发展新的合奏作品,直接塑造Toyful音乐节2026的节目单(10月23日-11月22日)。
opportunities.summary_en: The residency invites composers and performer-researchers to explore 'play' as a creative method through 'material play' and 'system play', developing new ensemble works that directly shape the program of Toyful Festival 2026 (October 23 - November 22).

opportunities.id: agg-landscape-2026-international-photography-exhibit-cur
opportunities.title_zh: 《风景 2026》国际摄影展
opportunities.title_en: Landscape 2026, International Photography Exhibition
opportunities.summary_zh: 以风景为主题的国际摄影展,展期一个月,在格拉斯哥画廊及线上展出。可提交至多8张JPEG。入选者获数字证书、展览照片,并有机会入选“月度摄影师”获社媒推广。
opportunities.summary_en: An international photography exhibition themed 'Landscape', shown for one month at Glasgow Gallery and online. Submit up to 8 JPEGs. Selected artists receive a digital certificate, exhibition photos, and a chance to be 'Photographer of the Month' with social media promotion.

opportunities.id: agg-stories-2026-international-photography-exhibitio-cur
opportunities.title_zh: 《故事 2026》国际摄影展
opportunities.title_en: Stories 2026, International Photography Exhibition
opportunities.summary_zh: 以“故事”为主题的国际摄影展,2026年11月4-28日在格拉斯哥举办。可提交至多8张作品,可标价出售。入选者获数字证书、展览照片,并有机会入选“月度摄影师”及年终画册。
opportunities.summary_en: An international photography exhibition themed 'Stories', held in Glasgow from November 4-28, 2026. Submit up to 8 works, which may be priced for sale. Selected artists receive a digital certificate, exhibition photos, and a chance to be 'Photographer of the Month' and featured in the annual catalogue.

opportunities.id: agg-peninsula-the-south-west-open-2026-cur
opportunities.title_zh: 《半岛——西南公开展 2026》
opportunities.title_en: Peninsula - The South West Open 2026

eligibility.nationality: 无需身处英国西南地区即可投稿
eligibility.nationality_en: Not required to be based in the South West of England to submit

opportunities.summary_zh: 回应英国西南地区风貌的夏季策划展,2026年7月26日至9月4日在托尔基Artizan画廊举办。单件投稿£15,多件£40。设£150现金奖给总冠军,销售抽成35%。
opportunities.summary_en: A summer curated exhibition responding to the landscape of the South West of England, held at Artizan Gallery, Torquay from July 26 to September 4, 2026. £15 for single entry, £40 for multiple. £150 cash prize for the overall winner, 35% sales commission.

opportunities.id: curatorspace-opportunities-艺术家电影与动态影像作品放映公开征集
opportunities.title_zh: 艺术家电影与动态影像作品放映公开征集
opportunities.title_en: Open Call for Screening Artist Film and Moving Image Works
opportunities.summary_zh: Deep Focus 面向全球征集10分钟以内的动态影像作品，主题为“吸引力”。入选作品将于2026年10月至12月在伦敦金史密斯学院RHB影院放映。免费提交，无资金支持，优先考虑能到场参与的艺术家。
opportunities.summary_en: Deep Focus seeks dynamic image works under 10 mins on the theme 'Attraction'. Selected works will be screened at RHB Cinema, Goldsmiths, London from Oct to Dec 2026. Free submission, no funding, priority to artists who can attend.

opportunities.id: agg-open-call-transient-states-paris-july-2026-cur
opportunities.title_zh: 公开征集:《过渡状态》——巴黎,2026年7月
opportunities.title_en: Open Call: Transient States - Paris, July 2026

eligibility.nationality: 欢迎国际及本地新锐与中生代艺术家
eligibility.nationality_en: International and local emerging and mid-career artists welcome

opportunities.summary_zh: 探讨转化、生成与“介于状态之间”形态的展览,2026年7月20-22日在巴黎玛莱区臻艺画廊展出。可提交2-3件作品,无需到场,运费自理,销售0抽成。入选须付£170/€200参展费。
opportunities.summary_en: Exhibition exploring transformation, generation, and 'in-between states', held July 20-22, 2026 at Zhen Yi Gallery, Marais, Paris. Submit 2-3 works, no attendance required, shipping at own cost, 0% commission on sales. Selected must pay £170/€200 participation fee.

opportunities.id: agg-under-the-skin-of-things-cur
opportunities.title_zh: 《事物的表皮之下》
opportunities.title_en: Under the Skin of Things

eligibility.nationality: 欢迎所有国家、所有媒介的艺术家
eligibility.nationality_en: Artists of all nationalities and all media welcome

opportunities.summary_zh: 线上展览,邀请艺术家看向表象之下、探讨当代生活的隐匿维度,涉及记忆、身份、生态、政治、科技、身体等。2026年8月1-30日在CISTA ARTS平台展出,销售0抽成。入选1件£30、2件£50。
opportunities.summary_en: Online exhibition inviting artists to look beneath the surface and explore hidden dimensions of contemporary life, including memory, identity, ecology, politics, technology, body, etc. Held Aug 1-30, 2026 on CISTA ARTS platform, 0% commission. £30 for 1 work, £50 for 2 works selected.

opportunities.id: agg-the-ghost-in-the-space-cur
opportunities.title_zh: 《空间中的幽灵》
opportunities.title_en: The Ghost in the Space

eligibility.nationality: 公开征集,欢迎所有阶段与国籍
eligibility.nationality_en: Open call, all stages and nationalities welcome

opportunities.summary_zh: 线上群展,探讨物理与数字空间中的无形残留,涉及数字痕迹、AI重构之声、空间记忆、缺席与监控等主题。入选作品在3D KUNSTMATRIX平台展出并获媒体推广,5-10位入选者有50/50分成机会。
opportunities.summary_en: Online group exhibition exploring intangible residues in physical and digital spaces, involving digital traces, AI-reconstructed voices, spatial memory, absence, surveillance, etc. Selected works displayed on 3D KUNSTMATRIX platform with media promotion; 5-10 artists have 50/50 split opportunity.

opportunities.id: agg-flora-fauna-photography-exhibition-cur
opportunities.title_zh: 《植物 / 动物》摄影展
opportunities.title_en: Flora / Fauna Photography Exhibition
opportunities.summary_zh: 线上国际摄影展,围绕“植物/动物”主题,探讨自然中的差异与关联、生长、适应、生存及人类对栖息地的影响。可提交至多5张JPG。入选者作品线上展出、进入数字画册并获参展证书。
opportunities.summary_en: Online international photography exhibition themed 'Flora/Fauna', exploring differences and connections in nature, growth, adaptation, survival, and human impact on habitats. Submit up to 5 JPGs. Selected works displayed online, included in digital catalog, and receive exhibition certificate.

opportunities.id: agg-open-call-museum-of-homeland-cur
opportunities.title_zh: 公开征集:《家园博物馆》
opportunities.title_en: Open Call: Museum of Homeland
opportunities.deadline_note: 列表显示18/07/2026;FAQ称目前无固定截止日期,滚动审阅

eligibility.nationality: 任何有移民经历者,不限来源国、目的地、背景、年龄或职业
eligibility.nationality_en: Anyone with migration experience, regardless of origin, destination, background, age, or occupation

opportunities.summary_zh: 线上虚拟博物馆,征集有移民经历者的日常物件及个人叙事。投稿含1-5张照片及说明物件对其移民故事意义的文字,入选者作品进入线上收藏。参与不付酬。
opportunities.summary_en: Online virtual museum seeking everyday objects and personal narratives from those with migration experience. Submit 1-5 photos and text explaining the object's significance to your migration story. Selected works enter online collection. No compensation for participation.
opportunities.deadline_note_en: Listed as 18/07/2026; FAQ states no fixed deadline, rolling review

opportunities.id: agg-post-animal-signal-cur
opportunities.title_zh: 《后——动物信号》
opportunities.title_en: Post - Animal Signal

eligibility.nationality: 面向所有国家的艺术家、电影人、声音艺术家、学生及独立实践者
eligibility.nationality_en: Open to artists, filmmakers, sound artists, students, and independent practitioners of all nationalities

opportunities.summary_zh: 国际征集,探讨动物性、非人感知、生态想象及新兴人—非人关系。作品于2026年7月28-31日在苏格兰格拉斯哥Molend Space展出。面向所有国家的艺术家、学生及独立实践者,入选参展费£50。
opportunities.summary_en: International open call exploring animality, non-human perception, ecological imagination, and emerging human-nonhuman relationships. The works will be exhibited at Molend Space in Glasgow, Scotland from July 28-31, 2026. Open to artists, students, and independent practitioners of all nationalities. Selected participants pay a fee of £50.

opportunities.id: agg-take-to-the-greenwood-cur
opportunities.title_zh: 《遁入绿林》
opportunities.title_en: take to the greenwood
opportunities.summary_zh: 探讨LGBTQIA+群体与自然关系的群展,取意“遁入绿林”。8月3-15日在CASS Art内的社区空间展出,销售0抽成但不保证成交。因商业场地要求,不接受全裸正面作品。
opportunities.summary_en: A group exhibition exploring the relationship between the LGBTQIA+ community and nature, taking its meaning from 'going to the greenwood'. Held from August 3-15 at a community space within CASS Art, with no commission on sales but no guarantee of sale. Due to commercial venue restrictions, full frontal nudity is not accepted.

opportunities.id: agg-equinox-virtual-exhibition-with-bobcat-gallery-cur
opportunities.title_zh: 《春分》——BobCat画廊线上展
opportunities.title_en: Equinox - Virtual Exhibition with BobCat Gallery
opportunities.summary_zh: 以春分“昼夜平衡”为主题的线上展,2026年9月1-30日举办。接受2D/3D原创作品,每人至多4件;不接受复制印刷品、数字作品及NFT。免费申请,入选付£5参展费,销售抽成20%。
opportunities.summary_en: An online exhibition themed 'Day and Night in Balance' for the spring equinox, held from September 1-30, 2026. Accepts original 2D/3D works, up to 4 pieces per person; no reproductions, digital works or NFTs. Free to apply, selected participants pay a fee of £5, with a 20% commission on sales.

opportunities.id: agg-stories-in-motion-call-for-young-artists-ages-7--cur
opportunities.title_zh: 《动态中的故事》:青年艺术家征集(7-20岁)
opportunities.title_en: Stories in Motion: Call for Young Artists (Ages 7-20)
opportunities.summary_zh: 面向7-20岁青年艺术家的视觉叙事展,入选作品2026年8月1-29日在伦敦Deptford Lounge展出,并可参与与加拿大多伦多的国际创意交流。每人至多投2件、至多入选1件;未满18岁需监护人代为注册。
opportunities.summary_en: A visual narrative exhibition for young artists aged 7-20. Selected works will be exhibited at Deptford Lounge in London from August 1-29, 2026, with an opportunity for international creative exchange with Toronto, Canada. Each artist can submit up to 2 works and be selected for at most 1; those under 18 must be registered by a guardian.

opportunities.id: agg-suspended-last-few-places-added-cur
opportunities.title_zh: 《悬置》——追加名额
opportunities.title_en: Suspended - Last Few Places Added

eligibility.nationality: 欢迎国际及本地新锐与中生代艺术家,不限媒介
eligibility.nationality_en: Welcome to international and local emerging and mid-career artists, all media

opportunities.summary_zh: 探讨感知与“悬置”状态的展览二次征集,涉及等待、过渡、平衡/坍塌、重力、心理不稳定与流离等。2026年8月6-10日在巴黎玛莱区臻艺画廊展出,销售0抽成,入选须付£200/€230。
opportunities.summary_en: A second call for an exhibition exploring perception and the state of 'suspension', involving waiting, transition, balance/collapse, gravity, psychological instability, and displacement. Held from August 6-10, 2026 at Zhen Yi Gallery in the Marais district of Paris. No commission on sales, selected participants pay £200/€230.

opportunities.id: artconnect-opportunities-寻找工作坊领导者
opportunities.title_zh: 寻找工作坊领导者
opportunities.title_en: Seeking Workshop Leaders
opportunities.summary_zh: 大自然保护协会纽约安迪·沃霍尔视觉艺术项目征集艺术家，在2026年秋季于安迪·沃霍尔保护区领导户外工作坊。四位艺术家将被选中，需设计适合各年龄段、与保护区自然景观相关的艺术创作工作坊。
opportunities.summary_en: The Nature Conservancy's Andy Warhol Visual Art Program in New York seeks artists to lead outdoor workshops at the Andy Warhol Preserve in the fall of 2026. Four artists will be selected, and must design art-making workshops suitable for all ages, related to the preserve's natural landscape.

opportunities.id: artconnect-opportunities-圣达菲铁路场公园-广场公共艺术公开征集
opportunities.title_zh: 圣达菲铁路场公园+广场公共艺术公开征集
opportunities.title_en: Public Art Open Call: Santa Fe’s Railyard Park + Plaza
opportunities.summary_zh: 圣达菲市RAP委员会征集铁路场公园+广场的临时公共艺术装置和创意项目提案，鼓励跨学科合作，作品需适应户外展示并回应场地自然与社会景观。
opportunities.summary_en: The Santa Fe RAP Commission is soliciting proposals for temporary public art installations and creative projects for the Rail Yard Park + Plaza, encouraging interdisciplinary collaboration, with works needing to be suitable for outdoor display and responsive to the site's natural and social landscape.

opportunities.id: artconnect-opportunities-展览征集
opportunities.title_zh: 展览征集
opportunities.title_en: Call for Exhibitions
opportunities.summary_zh: 南内华达学院美术系现征集2025-2026展览季的展览提案，涵盖多个画廊空间。接受所有媒介和类型的个展或群展，由教师委员会根据艺术质量、与学院使命的相关性等标准评选。申请免费，截止日期为2026年9月15日。
opportunities.summary_en: The Fine Arts Department at College of Southern Nevada is currently seeking exhibition proposals for the 2025-2026 exhibition season, covering multiple gallery spaces. All media and types of solo or group exhibitions are accepted, selected by a faculty committee based on artistic quality, relevance to the college's mission, and other criteria. Free to apply, deadline September 15, 2026.

opportunities.id: artconnect-opportunities-夏洛特市雕塑公开征集
opportunities.title_zh: 夏洛特市雕塑公开征集
opportunities.title_en: Open Call for Sculpture in City of Charlotte
opportunities.summary_zh: Arts & Science Council为夏洛特市动物护理与控制中心征集悬挂雕塑、墙面浮雕或壁画作品，要求艺术家参考该中心愿景，作品需与建筑互补并体现社区历史。
opportunities.summary_en: The Arts & Science Council is seeking proposals for suspended sculptures, wall reliefs, or murals for the Charlotte Animal Care and Control Center, requiring artists to reference the center's vision, with works needing to complement the building and reflect community history.

opportunities.id: artconnect-opportunities-现场项目策展人
opportunities.title_zh: 现场项目策展人
opportunities.title_en: Live Programmes Curator
opportunities.summary_zh: 蛇形画廊招聘一位经验丰富的跨学科策展人，负责发起、开发并制作动态的现场项目，通过讲座、表演、参与式体验和跨学科现场形式，扩展和激活画廊的展览与策展愿景。
opportunities.summary_en: Serpentine Galleries is seeking an experienced interdisciplinary curator to initiate, develop and produce dynamic live projects that expand and activate the gallery's exhibition and curatorial vision through talks, performances, participatory experiences and interdisciplinary live formats.

opportunities.id: artconnect-opportunities-欧洲及更远流动性计划
opportunities.title_zh: 欧洲及更远流动性计划
opportunities.title_en: Europe and Beyond Mobility Programme
opportunities.summary_zh: RESEO的欧洲及更远流动性计划为艺术家和专业人士提供财务援助，参与2026年10月在布鲁塞尔举行的RESEO会议，旨在促进国际交流与知识共享。
opportunities.summary_en: RESEO's Mobility Scheme for Europe and Beyond provides financial assistance for artists and professionals to participate in the RESEO Conference in Brussels in October 2026, aiming to foster international exchange and knowledge sharing.

opportunities.id: artconnect-opportunities-锡安国家公园驻留艺术家2027
opportunities.title_zh: 锡安国家公园驻留艺术家2027
opportunities.title_en: Zion National Park Artist-in-Residence 2027
opportunities.summary_zh: 锡安国家公园2027年驻留项目，面向画家、雕塑家、纤维艺术家、纸艺家、木雕家、摄影师、电影制作人、音乐家、表演者、舞者、小说家和诗人。驻留月份为2027年2月、6月、10月中旬至11月中旬。艺术家需自行承担往返交通及材料费用。
opportunities.summary_en: Zion National Park's 2027 residency program is open to painters, sculptors, fiber artists, paper artists, woodcarvers, photographers, filmmakers, musicians, performers, dancers, novelists and poets. Residency months are February, June, and mid-October to mid-November 2027. Artists are responsible for their own round-trip transportation and material costs.

opportunities.id: artconnect-opportunities-解释性面板-公共艺术机会
opportunities.title_zh: 解释性面板：公共艺术机会
opportunities.title_en: Interpretive Panels: Public Art Opportunity
opportunities.summary_zh: Creative Philadelphia 发起公开征集，委托艺术家团队设计并制作四块永久性解释性面板，集成增强现实（AR）元素，位于费城市政服务大楼。欢迎所有艺术家申请，费城本地艺术家优先。
opportunities.summary_en: Creative Philadelphia launches an open call to commission an artist team to design and fabricate four permanent interpretive panels with integrated augmented reality (AR) elements, located at the Philadelphia Municipal Services Building. All artists are welcome to apply, with local Philadelphia artists given priority.

opportunities.id: artconnect-opportunities-up-基金会策展奖学金
opportunities.title_zh: Upė基金会策展奖学金
opportunities.title_en: Upė Foundation Curatorial Fellowship at Camden Art Centre
opportunities.summary_zh: Upė基金会与Camden艺术中心合作，为波罗的海地区早期策展人提供为期12个月的全职策展奖学金，可延长至18个月。入选者将担任助理策展人，参与展览策划、协调与执行，并获得专业发展指导。需迁居伦敦。
opportunities.summary_en: The Upė Foundation, in partnership with Camden Art Centre, offers a full-time 12-month curatorial fellowship for early-career curators from the Baltic region, extendable to 18 months. The selected fellow will serve as Assistant Curator, involved in exhibition planning, coordination, and execution, and will receive professional development mentorship. Must relocate to London.

opportunities.id: curatorspace-opportunities-玻璃商cgs毕业生奖与新毕业生回顾2026
opportunities.title_zh: 玻璃商CGS毕业生奖与新毕业生回顾2026
opportunities.title_en: Glass Sellers' CGS Graduate Prize and New Graduate Review 2026
opportunities.summary_zh: 当代玻璃协会（CGS）推出2026年玻璃商毕业生奖与新毕业生回顾，面向2025/2026年欧洲认证课程毕业生，作品至少50%玻璃。获奖作品将刊登于《玻璃网络》杂志及数字出版物，奖金及代金券。免费报名，需为CGS会员。
opportunities.summary_en: The Contemporary Glass Society (CGS) launches the Glass Sellers CGS Graduate Award and New Graduate Review 2026, open to graduates from European accredited courses in 2025/2026 with works at least 50% glass. Winning works will be published in Glass Network magazine and digital publications, with cash prizes and vouchers. Free entry, must be CGS member.
opportunities.cover_audit: 2026-07-18 审核撤换(封面图来自第三方聚合)

opportunities.id: curatorspace-opportunities-blandford艺术协会2026年8月公开展览
opportunities.title_zh: Blandford艺术协会2026年8月公开展览
opportunities.title_en: Blandford Art Society Open Exhibition August 2026
opportunities.summary_zh: Blandford艺术协会举办2026年8月公开展览，面向多塞特、汉普郡、萨默塞特和威尔特郡的艺术家征集原创作品。接受画布、框架作品、雕塑及纺织作品。提交截止2026年7月12日，会员每件6英镑，非会员10英镑。展览于8月15日至21日在Corn Exchange举行。
opportunities.summary_en: Blandford Art Society presents the August 2026 Open Exhibition, inviting artists from Dorset, Hampshire, Somerset, and Wiltshire to submit original works. Accepts canvas, framed works, sculpture, and textiles. Submission deadline July 12, 2026. Members £6 per piece, non-members £10. Exhibition runs August 15-21 at the Corn Exchange.

opportunities.title_en: Dreams and Nightmares | Call For Artists

opportunities.summary_en: The Light Frame Gallery invites guest writers for its online journal, seeking 1500-2000 word research articles exploring how museums and photography can promote community well-being. Selected writers receive £50 per article. Open call ongoing.
opportunities.deadline_note_en: Rolling open call

opportunities.deadline_note_en: Rolling deadline, works change approximately every six weeks

opportunities.summary_en: No.name Studio is located in Zhujiajiao Ancient Town, Shanghai, offering artist residencies from 1 week to 3 months, welcoming any form of artistic creation. Residency fee is 7000 RMB in winter, 10000 RMB in spring/summer/autumn. Artists are responsible for their own travel, meals, materials, and personal expenses. Airport pickup available.
opportunities.deadline_note_en: Applications accepted year-round

opportunities.id: chinaresidencies-directory-fuse-驻留项目
opportunities.title_zh: FUSE 驻留项目
opportunities.title_en: FUSE
opportunities.summary_zh: 錄映太奇是香港非营利新媒体艺术组织，其FUSE驻留项目邀请本地及国际艺术家、策展人等提交新媒体艺术项目提案，驻留期1-6个月，提供创作资源及项目执行津贴，但国际驻留者需自行承担旅费、住宿及生活开销。
opportunities.summary_en: Videotage is a non-profit new media art organization in Hong Kong. Its FUSE residency program invites local and international artists, curators, etc. to submit proposals for new media art projects. Residency period: 1-6 months. Provides creative resources and project execution grants, but international residents must cover their own travel, accommodation, and living expenses.
opportunities.deadline_note_en: Applications accepted year-round

opportunities.deadline_note: Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

opportunities.summary_en: The Chinese European Art Center (CEAC) residency program is open to visual artists, designers, architects, curators, writers, musicians, etc. Provides fully equipped living/working spaces, supports cross-media creation, and organizes cultural exchange activities. Applications accepted year-round. Monthly fee 10,000 RMB.
opportunities.deadline_note_en: Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

The focus is on watermark printmaking materials, techniques, creative applications, mounting and preservation, etc. Funded projects include key projects, general projects, and self-funded projects, with a research period of 1-2 years.

opportunities.summary_en: The Fondation François Schneider launches the first edition of the "Talents Contemporains – La Terre" competition, themed "Earth" (La Terre), for sculpture and installation works. Winning works will be acquired and exhibited in the gardens of the Pontigny Abbey, with all transportation costs fully covered by the foundation.
